A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BFS-Prover-V2. Their main text, figures, table, mathematical content, and Appendices A–C are readable and support comparison across the changed pagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results in Table 1, training trajectories in Figure 3, and generated-proof and search outcomes in Appendices A and B.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including miniF2F and ProofNet evaluations and the appendix proof case studies.

M1.justification: Appendix C.2 revises the specified replanning procedure. v1 preserves the entire original plan and inserts steps before the stuck subgoal; v2 preserves proven subgoals and permits correcting or decomposing the stuck subgoal while regenerating the remaining plan. The training algorithm and overall planner–prover architecture remain.

E1.justification: Training sources, miniF2F and ProofNet evaluation coverage, and the problems examined in Appendices A and B are unchanged. Additional replanning demonstrations reuse problems already present as planning examples; they do not establish new evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same step-level and whole-proof comparators. Appendix A also retains the same DeepSeek-Prover-V2 and Compfiles human-proof comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported planner prompting setup changes in Appendix C.2: replanning receives proven subgoals instead of the full initial plan, and supplied replanning demonstrations increase from one to three. Section 3's models, training schedules, BFS parameters, and Table 1 budgets remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish that evaluations were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix A.1 revises the proof-conciseness case study by replacing the aime_1984_p7 proof with a single simp tactic and updating its comparison with DeepSeek-Prover-V2. Other case studies remain, including Appendix B's unchanged replanning example reporting failure after 7,200 attempts versus success within 800.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained training rounds and proof-search attempt counts are not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: The reported aime_1984_p7 output changes from a multi-command proof ending in simp and linarith to simp [h1, h0] alone. Table 1 and Figure 3 results are unchanged, including the headline 95.08% miniF2F-test and 41.4% ProofNet-test scores.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1 replaces the formal proof script for aime_1984_p7 with a single simplification proof, a localized proof revision. Its theorem statement and Section 2.1's MDP definitions remain unchanged; no new theoretical guarantee is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract newly characterizes the system as open source and announces released models and code. The dual-scaling contributions and benchmark claims remain; the more prominent ProofNet generalization claim in Section 1.2 already appeared in v1's Section 3.

C2.justification: The explanations of training plateaus, adaptive filtering, hierarchical search, and generalization to ProofNet retain their meaning. Appendix A's limitation concerning poor human readability of step-level proofs is unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a model/code release statement, repository link, and project-page link, absent from v1. Appendix C.2 also supplies revised prompt templates and additional replanning examples. These are changes in documented access and implementation information; external artifact availability was not inspected.

R1.justification: The same 43 references and substantive relationships to earlier step-level and whole-proof approaches are retained. The revised introductory emphasis does not establish a new research-positioning argument.

P1.justification: There are localized prose edits in the abstract, introduction, conclusion, and case studies, plus substantial rewriting within the planner prompts and clearer input/output labels. The paper's section hierarchy and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is redrawn with larger labels and an explicit 10^7-tree-search annotation on the horizontal axis. Appendix B starts on a new page, and proof and prompt boxes reflow. The same four figures and single benchmark table are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reproducibility documentation through model/code access information and more explicit replanning templates and examples. Figure 3 is also easier to read. These gains are limited: benchmark evidence and statistical support remain unchanged, and no new results establish the effect of the revised prompting procedure.
